content.title: Bad news for Lakers: Austin Reaves return timeline revealed
content.text: Austin Reaves is expected to miss the majority of the first round, with his return timeline more realistically set around the first week of May. The Los Angeles Lakers likely to will have to deal without one of their main stars Austin Reaves in the first round series against the Houston Rockets. According to Shams Charania of ESPN, Reaves is expected to miss the majority of the first round, with his return timeline more realistically set around the first week of May. "Austin Reaves is out for the majority of the first-round series; most likely the earliest for him is going to be the first week of May," Charania reported on the Pat McAfee Show. Charania also provided an update on Luka Doncic, revealing that he's set to comeback to U.S. on Tuesday after his treatment in Spain, and will get reevaluated here. "Luka Doncic spent the last week in Spain and underwent multiple injection treatments in that hamstring to see if he can promote quicker healing. From my understanding, he'll be back in the States on Tuesday and they're going to reevaluate him," he reported. The Lakers will have home-court advantage in the first round against the Houston Rockets. The series will begin April 18 in Los Angeles. Like what we are doing? You can express your gratitude here.
